summary: Z-Image (Alibaba, 6B). The cheap-iteration card. Whole stack is 17GB bf16 / 9.3GB int8 — runs on a 24GB consumer card, so a hundred candidate frames cost pennies.
vramNote: ESTIMATE. 11.5GB model + 5.3GB encoder + activations. Measure and replace.
note: Take z_image_bf16, NOT z_image_turbo — turbo is the distilled variant and 5M of its downloads are people shipping slop. int8_convrot (5.78GB) is quantisation, not distillation, and is a legitimate fallback if VRAM is tight.
